name: adversarial-squad
description: Deploy a bounded, profile-loaded adversarial review squad at a mission point-cut so independent doctrine lenses converge on findings one reviewer would miss. Triggers: "deploy a squad", "adversarial squad", "post-tasks anti-laziness pass", "pre-spec investigation squad", "brownfield check", "second opinion on this design", "review squad", "run a multi-lens review". Does NOT handle: the implement-review loop (use spec-kitty-implement-review), spec/plan/tasks generation, or direct code editing by the orchestrator. It is an optional, charter/memory-activated enrichment — it never gates a mission.
